items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN,
I’ve been working on Wayther for a few years now. It's an iOS app that shows the forecast at each point of your journey, timed to when you are expected to get there. It allows you to compare alternative routes, adjust your departure time and see how rain, wind, visibility and temperature may affect your drive.
